source.text: לֹא־יִקַּ֥ח אִ֖ישׁ אֶת־אֵ֣שֶׁת אָבִ֑יו וְלֹ֥א יְגַלֶּ֖ה כְּנַ֥ף אָבִֽיו׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Not shall take a man [the] wife of his father, and not he shall uncover [the] skirt of his father.

en.L: A man shall not take his father's wife, and he shall not uncover his father's skirt.
en.B: A man must not marry his father's wife; he must not uncover the edge of his father's garment.
en.R: A man must not marry his father's wife. He must not take for himself the woman who belongs to his father.

es.L: Un hombre no tomará a la mujer de su padre, ni descubrirá el borde [del manto] de su padre.
es.B: Un hombre no debe casarse con la mujer de su padre; no debe descubrir el borde del manto de su padre.
es.R: Un hombre no debe casarse con la esposa de su padre. No debe tomar para sí a la mujer que pertenece a su padre.

fr.L: Un homme ne prendra pas la femme de son père, et il ne découvrira pas le pan [du manteau] de son père.
fr.B: Un homme ne doit pas épouser la femme de son père ; il ne doit pas soulever le pan du manteau de son père.
fr.R: Un homme ne doit pas épouser la femme de son père. Il ne doit pas prendre pour lui la femme qui appartient à son père.

sw.L: Mtu asimtwae mke wa baba yake, wala asifunue upindo wa [vazi la] baba yake.
sw.B: Mwanamume asimwoe mke wa baba yake; asifunue upindo wa vazi la baba yake.
sw.R: Mwanamume asimwoe mke wa baba yake. Asimchukue kuwa wake mwanamke aliye wa baba yake.

vi.L: Một người không được lấy vợ của cha mình, và không được tốc vạt áo của cha mình.
vi.B: Một người không được cưới vợ của cha mình; người ấy không được tốc vạt áo của cha mình.
vi.R: Không ai được cưới vợ của cha mình. Không ai được lấy làm của mình người đàn bà thuộc về cha mình.

ko.L: 남자는 자기 아버지의 아내를 취하지 말고, 자기 아버지의 옷자락을 들추지 말라.
ko.B: 남자는 아버지의 아내를 아내로 맞아서는 안 된다. 아버지의 옷자락을 들추어서는 안 된다.
ko.R: 남자는 자기 아버지의 아내와 결혼하면 안 됩니다. 아버지에게 속한 여자를 자기 것으로 삼으면 안 됩니다.

pt.L: Um homem não tomará a mulher do seu pai, e não descobrirá a aba [da roupa] do seu pai.
pt.B: Nenhum homem se casará com a mulher do seu pai; não descobrirá a borda da roupa do seu pai.
pt.R: Um homem não pode se casar com a mulher do seu pai. Ele não pode tomar para si a mulher que pertence ao pai.

decisions.choice: verse numbers: in many Bibles this verse is 22:30
decisions.reason: This translation numbers verses as the Hebrew text does. In the Hebrew text this verse opens chapter 23; many Bibles number it 22:30, the last verse of chapter 22, and so number the rest of this chapter (23:2-26 here) 23:1-25. The words are the same; only the numbers differ.

decisions.choice: take his father's wife: marry her, or take her as his own, after the father's death or divorce
decisions.reason: "Take" a woman is the usual way of saying "marry" (22:13-14; 24:1). The father's wife here is a wife other than the man's own mother: a stepmother, or a widow of the father. Leviticus 18:8 and 20:11 forbid the same union, and 27:20 below puts a curse on it. Reuben's act with his father's concubine shows how seriously it was taken (Genesis 35:22; 49:4).

decisions.choice: uncover his father's skirt: violate what belongs to his father in marriage
alternatives: a separate act of indecency toward the father himself
decisions.reason: To spread the edge of one's garment over a woman was a sign of taking her as wife (Ruth 3:9; Ezekiel 16:8). To uncover the father's garment is to lay bare what that covering protects, his marriage, and so to shame him. The same words return in 27:20.

decisions.choice: still Moses speaking: part of the speech that began at 5:1
decisions.reason: The chapter lies inside Moses' long speech of 5:1-26:19, so no new speech begins here. This verse rounds off the laws on marriage and sexual wrongs in 22:13-29.

decisions.choice: the edge of his father's garment
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word means a wing or the corner of a garment. Balanced keeps the picture and says "edge of ... garment" so it is not read as a modern skirt; Literal keeps "skirt".

decisions.choice: take for himself the woman who belongs to his father
decisions.reason: Readable says what the picture means (m3) instead of keeping it.

decisions.choice: "tốc vạt áo của cha mình" (L, B)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew picture of uncovering the edge of the father's garment, which means violating what belongs to the father in marriage (meaning decision); Readable says it plainly, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "아버지의 옷자락을 들추다" (Literal, Balanced), "아버지에게 속한 여자를 자기 것으로 삼다" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew picture, as the English Balanced does; the Readable says what it means.

decisions.choice: a aba [da roupa] (L); a borda da roupa (B)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is the wing or corner of a garment (m3). Literal says "aba", the flap of a garment, and brackets what Portuguese needs to make it a garment; Balanced says "a borda da roupa", as the English Balanced says "edge of ... garment". Readable says what the picture means, as the English Readable does.

source.text: לֹֽא־יָבֹ֧א פְצֽוּעַ־דַּכָּ֛א וּכְר֥וּת שָׁפְכָ֖ה בִּקְהַ֥ל יְהוָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Not shall enter [one] wounded of crushing and [one] cut off of [the] male organ into [the] assembly of Yahweh.

en.L: One wounded by crushing or cut off in the male organ shall not enter the assembly of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: No man whose testicles have been crushed or whose penis has been cut off may enter the assembly of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: A man whose sex organs have been crushed or cut off may not join the assembly of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: No entrará el herido por aplastamiento ni el que tiene cortado el miembro viril en la asamblea {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Ningún hombre que tenga los testículos aplastados o el pene cortado podrá entrar en la asamblea {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Un hombre cuyos órganos sexuales hayan sido aplastados o cortados no puede formar parte de la asamblea {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Celui qui est blessé par écrasement ou qui a le membre viril coupé n’entrera pas dans l’assemblée {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Aucun homme dont les testicules ont été écrasés ou dont le pénis a été coupé ne peut entrer dans l’assemblée {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Un homme dont les organes sexuels ont été écrasés ou coupés ne peut pas faire partie de l’assemblée {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Aliyejeruhiwa kwa kupondwa au aliyekatwa kiungo cha uume hataingia katika kusanyiko la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Mwanamume yeyote ambaye korodani zake zimepondwa au uume wake umekatwa asiingie katika kusanyiko la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Mwanamume ambaye viungo vyake vya uzazi vimepondwa au kukatwa hawezi kujiunga na kusanyiko la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Người bị dập [tinh hoàn] hay bị cắt dương vật không được vào hội của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Người nào bị dập tinh hoàn hay bị cắt dương vật thì không được vào hội của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Người đàn ông nào có bộ phận sinh dục bị dập hay bị cắt thì không được gia nhập hội của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 고환이 상한 자나 음경이 잘린 자는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 총회에 들어오지 못한다.
ko.B: 고환이 으깨졌거나 음경이 잘린 남자는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 총회에 들어올 수 없다.
ko.R: 생식기가 으깨졌거나 잘린 남자는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 총회에 들어올 수 없습니다.

pt.L: Não entrará o ferido por esmagamento nem o que tem cortado o membro na assembleia {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.B: Nenhum homem que tenha os testículos esmagados ou o pênis cortado poderá entrar na assembleia {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.R: Um homem que teve os órgãos sexuais esmagados ou cortados não pode fazer parte da assembleia {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.

decisions.choice: verse numbers: many Bibles begin chapter 23 here
decisions.reason: This translation numbers verses as the Hebrew text does. Many Bibles count the verse before this one as 22:30 and begin chapter 23 here, so 23:2-26 here is 23:1-25 there. The words are the same; only the numbers differ.

decisions.choice: wounded by crushing ... cut off: a man whose testicles have been crushed or whose penis has been cut off
decisions.reason: The first phrase names injury by crushing, most likely of the testicles (Leviticus 21:20; 22:24 use related words for blemished priests and animals); the second names cutting off of the male organ. Both describe men made unable to father children, whether by injury or, as was done to some royal servants and to devotees of certain gods, on purpose.

decisions.choice: enter the assembly of the LORD: belong to the people of Israel when they gather before the LORD
decisions.reason: "The assembly of the LORD" is Israel gathered as God's people, for worship, covenant and decision (4:10; 9:10; 31:30). To "enter" it is to be counted as a full member of it. The verse does not forbid such a man to live among Israel; the rules in verses 2-9 concern who may be counted in the assembly.

decisions.choice: later promise to eunuchs
decisions.reason: Isaiah 56:3-5 later promises eunuchs who keep the covenant a name and a place in God's house better than sons and daughters, looking beyond this rule.

decisions.choice: testicles ... penis / sex organs
decisions.reason: Balanced names the body parts plainly, as the Hebrew does; Readable uses a general phrase that is suitable for young readers. Literal keeps "crushing" and "the male organ".

decisions.choice: formar parte de la asamblea
decisions.reason: As the English "join": Readable says what entering the assembly means, membership; Literal and Balanced keep "entrar en". The same wording runs through verses 2-9.

decisions.choice: faire partie de l'assemblée
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew "enter". Readable says "faire partie de", since entering the assembly means being counted as a member of it, as the English "join" does; the same wording runs through verses 2-9.

decisions.choice: kujiunga na kusanyiko
decisions.reason: Readable says "kujiunga na" (join), the sense of entering the assembly; Literal and Balanced keep "kuingia katika". The same wording runs through verses 2-9.

decisions.choice: "hội của CHÚA" for the assembly of the LORD
decisions.reason: The term sheet keeps "hội" for qahal and "hội chúng" for ʿedah; the assembly here is Israel gathered before the LORD (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "주의 총회"
decisions.reason: Qahal is the term sheet's "총회"; the same phrase is used through verses 2-9.

decisions.choice: a assembleia do SENHOR (every level); entrar na assembleia (L, B), fazer parte da assembleia (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: Israel gathered as the LORD's people (m3) is "a assembleia", the word docs/pentateuch-portuguese-terms.md sets for qahal (4:10; 9:10 have it in Portuguese), with the article inside the setting span: "a assembleia {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}". "Comunidade" is kept for the other word, 'edah. Literal and Balanced keep the verb "entrar"; Readable says "fazer parte", as the English Readable says "join", since to enter is to be counted a member.

source.text: לֹא־יָבֹ֥א מַמְזֵ֖ר בִּקְהַ֣ל יְהוָ֑ה גַּ֚ם דּ֣וֹר עֲשִׂירִ֔י לֹא־יָ֥בֹא ל֖וֹ בִּקְהַ֥ל יְהוָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Not shall enter [one of] forbidden birth into [the] assembly of Yahweh; also a generation tenth, not shall enter of his into [the] assembly of Yahweh.

en.L: One of forbidden birth shall not enter the assembly of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; even the tenth generation, none of his shall enter the assembly of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: No one born of a forbidden union may enter the assembly of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. None of their descendants may enter it, not even in the tenth generation.
en.R: No one born from a forbidden marriage may join the assembly of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Even ten generations later, none of that person's descendants may join it.

es.L: No entrará el de nacimiento prohibido en la asamblea {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}; ni aun la décima generación, ninguno de los suyos entrará en la asamblea {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Nadie nacido de una unión prohibida podrá entrar en la asamblea {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Ninguno de sus descendientes podrá entrar en ella, ni siquiera en la décima generación.
es.R: Nadie que haya nacido de un matrimonio prohibido puede formar parte de la asamblea {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Ni siquiera diez generaciones después podrá formar parte de ella ninguno de sus descendientes.

fr.L: Celui qui est d’une naissance interdite n’entrera pas dans l’assemblée {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ; même la dixième génération, aucun des siens n’entrera dans l’assemblée {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Aucune personne née d’une union interdite ne peut entrer dans l’assemblée {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Aucun de ses descendants ne peut y entrer, pas même à la dixième génération.
fr.R: Une personne née d’un mariage interdit ne peut pas faire partie de l’assemblée {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Même dix générations plus tard, aucun de ses descendants ne pourra en faire partie.

sw.L: Mwenye kuzaliwa kwa muungano uliokatazwa hataingia katika kusanyiko la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; hata kizazi cha kumi, hakuna wa kwake atakayeingia katika kusanyiko la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Mtu yeyote aliyezaliwa kwa muungano uliokatazwa asiingie katika kusanyiko la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Hakuna hata mmoja wa wazao wake atakayeingia humo, hata katika kizazi cha kumi.
sw.R: Mtu aliyezaliwa katika ndoa iliyokatazwa hawezi kujiunga na kusanyiko la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Hata baada ya vizazi kumi, hakuna hata mmoja wa wazao wake atakayeweza kujiunga nalo.

vi.L: Con ngoại hôn không được vào hội của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; dù đến thế hệ thứ mười, không ai thuộc về người ấy được vào hội của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Người sinh ra từ một cuộc kết hợp bị cấm không được vào hội của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Dòng dõi người ấy cũng không được vào, dù đến thế hệ thứ mười.
vi.R: Người sinh ra từ một cuộc hôn nhân bị cấm không được gia nhập hội của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Dù đến mười thế hệ sau, con cháu người ấy cũng không được gia nhập.

ko.L: 사생아는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 총회에 들어오지 못한다. 십 대에 이르기까지 그에게 속한 자는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 총회에 들어오지 못한다.
ko.B: 금지된 관계에서 태어난 사람은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 총회에 들어올 수 없다. 그 자손은 십 대까지도 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 총회에 들어올 수 없다.
ko.R: 율법이 금지한 결혼에서 태어난 사람은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 총회에 들어올 수 없습니다. 그 사람의 자손은 열 세대가 지나도 들어올 수 없습니다.

pt.L: Não entrará o de nascimento proibido na assembleia {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}; mesmo a décima geração, nenhum dos seus entrará na assembleia {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.B: Ninguém nascido de uma união proibida poderá entrar na assembleia {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Nenhum dos seus descendentes poderá entrar nela, nem mesmo na décima geração.
pt.R: Ninguém que nasceu de um casamento proibido pode fazer parte da assembleia {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Mesmo dez gerações depois, nenhum descendente dessa pessoa pode fazer parte dela.

decisions.choice: one of forbidden birth: a child of a union the law forbids
alternatives: a child of a marriage with a foreigner
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is rare (here and Zechariah 9:6) and its meaning is not certain. Coming right after verse 1, it most likely names a child born of a union forbidden by the law, such as incest (Leviticus 18:6-18). In Zechariah 9:6 it names a mixed or alien people settling in a Philistine town, so some take it here as a child of a marriage between an Israelite and a foreigner. It does not mean simply a child born to unmarried parents.

decisions.choice: even the tenth generation: never
decisions.reason: Ten generations stands for a full and final span of time. In verse 4 the same phrase is followed by "forever", which shows that it means a lasting ban, not one that ends after ten generations (Nehemiah 13:1).

decisions.choice: their descendants
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "of his", meaning the person's offspring. Balanced says "their" because the rule covers anyone of such birth, male or female; Readable says "that person's". Literal keeps "of his".

decisions.choice: de nacimiento prohibido (L); nacido de una unión prohibida (B); nacido de un matrimonio prohibido (R)
decisions.reason: "Bastardo" and "ilegítimo" would point to a child of unmarried parents, which the meaning decision rules out.

decisions.choice: d'une naissance interdite (L); née d'une union interdite (B); née d'un mariage interdit (R)
decisions.reason: French "bâtard" or "illégitime" would mean a child of unmarried parents, which the meaning decision rules out. The wording keeps to a child of a union the law forbids.

decisions.choice: aliyezaliwa kwa muungano uliokatazwa (L, B); aliyezaliwa katika ndoa iliyokatazwa (R)
decisions.reason: "Mwana haramu" is the everyday word for a child born outside marriage, which the meaning decision rules out; the wording names a union the law forbids.

decisions.choice: "con ngoại hôn" (L) for mamzer
decisions.reason: The word means a child of a union the law forbids (meaning decision, footnoted); "con ngoại hôn" is neutral, while "con hoang" is an insult and narrower in sense.

decisions.choice: "사생아" (Literal), "금지된 관계에서 태어난 사람" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The meaning of mamzer is uncertain (the meaning decision footnotes it); the Literal uses the nearest single Korean word, the other levels the reading the English gives.

decisions.choice: o de nascimento proibido (L); nascido de uma união proibida (B); que nasceu de um casamento proibido (R)
decisions.reason: The rare word most likely names a child of a union the law forbids, such as incest (m1). "Bastardo" and "ilegítimo" mean any child born outside marriage, which is both wider and different, so each level says "proibido", as the English says "forbidden".

source.text: לֹֽא־יָבֹ֧א עַמּוֹנִ֛י וּמוֹאָבִ֖י בִּקְהַ֣ל יְהוָ֑ה גַּ֚ם דּ֣וֹר עֲשִׂירִ֔י לֹא־יָבֹ֥א לָהֶ֛ם בִּקְהַ֥ל יְהוָ֖ה עַד־עוֹלָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Not shall enter [an] Ammonite and [a] Moabite into [the] assembly of Yahweh; also a generation tenth, not shall enter of them into [the] assembly of Yahweh until perpetuity,

en.L: An Ammonite or a Moabite shall not enter the assembly of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; even the tenth generation, none of them shall enter the assembly of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} forever,
en.B: No Ammonite or Moabite may enter the assembly of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. None of them may ever enter it, not even in the tenth generation,
en.R: No Ammonite or Moabite may join the assembly of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Even ten generations later, none of their people may ever join it.

es.L: No entrará el amonita ni el moabita en la asamblea {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}; ni aun la décima generación, ninguno de ellos entrará en la asamblea {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, para siempre,
es.B: Ningún amonita ni moabita podrá entrar en la asamblea {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Ninguno de ellos podrá entrar jamás en ella, ni siquiera en la décima generación,
es.R: Ningún amonita ni moabita puede formar parte de la asamblea {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Ni siquiera diez generaciones después podrá nadie de esos pueblos formar parte de ella jamás.

fr.L: L’Ammonite et le Moabite n’entreront pas dans l’assemblée {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ; même la dixième génération, aucun des leurs n’entrera dans l’assemblée {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, à jamais,
fr.B: Aucun Ammonite ni aucun Moabite ne peut entrer dans l’assemblée {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Aucun d’eux ne pourra jamais y entrer, pas même à la dixième génération,
fr.R: Aucun Ammonite ni aucun Moabite ne peut faire partie de l’assemblée {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Même dix générations plus tard, aucun membre de ces peuples ne pourra jamais en faire partie.

sw.L: Mwamoni wala Mmoabu hataingia katika kusanyiko la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; hata kizazi cha kumi, hakuna wa kwao atakayeingia katika kusanyiko la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} milele,
sw.B: Mwamoni au Mmoabu yeyote asiingie katika kusanyiko la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Hakuna hata mmoja wao atakayeingia humo kamwe, hata katika kizazi cha kumi,
sw.R: Mwamoni au Mmoabu yeyote hawezi kujiunga na kusanyiko la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Hata baada ya vizazi kumi, hakuna mtu wa mataifa hayo atakayeweza kujiunga nalo kamwe.

decisions.choice: Ammonite and Moabite: the peoples east of the Jordan descended from Lot
decisions.reason: Genesis 19:30-38 traces Moab and Ammon to Lot's two daughters. Israel was told not to attack them on the way to the land (2:9, 19). Their exclusion from the assembly rests on what they did when Israel passed by, given in verse 5.

decisions.choice: even the tenth generation ... forever: the ban never ends
decisions.reason: As in verse 3, "the tenth generation" stands for a full span, and here "forever" is added. Nehemiah 13:1-3 quotes this verse when the people separate from those of foreign descent.

decisions.choice: Ruth the Moabite: a later story that sits beside this law
alternatives: the law applies to men only
the law applies to all of both peoples
decisions.reason: Ruth, a woman of Moab, joins Israel, marries Boaz and becomes the great-grandmother of David (Ruth 1:16; 4:13-22). The book does not explain how that fits with this verse. Later Jewish teaching took the masculine forms here to apply to men only; the verse itself does not say.

decisions.choice: None of them may ever enter it
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable move "forever" into the main clause so the point is clear: the ban has no end. The sentence goes on into verse 5, which gives the reason; Readable ends here and starts verse 5 with "This is because".

records.literal_gloss: because of [the] matter that not they met you with bread and with water on the way in your going out from Egypt, and that he hired against you Balaam son of Beor from Pethor of Aram-naharaim to curse you.

en.B: because they did not come to meet you with food and water on your journey after you left Egypt, and because Moab hired Balaam son of Beor, from Pethor in Aram-naharaim, to put a curse on you.

decisions.choice: meet you with bread and water: greet travelers with food as a welcome
decisions.reason: To go out and meet travelers with bread and water was a basic act of hospitality to people passing through (Genesis 14:18; 1 Samuel 25:18). Moses had asked Edom and Moab to sell food and water (2:6, 28-29); the charge here is that Ammon and Moab offered no welcome to a people in need.

decisions.choice: he hired: the king of Moab
decisions.reason: The subject changes from "they" (both peoples) to "he". It was Balak king of Moab who sent for Balaam (Numbers 22:2-7), so "he" is Moab, or its king. The address also moves from "you" plural to "you" singular, as Deuteronomy often does.

decisions.choice: Balaam son of Beor: the seer Balak hired to curse Israel
decisions.reason: Numbers 22-24 tells the story: Balaam came, but the LORD made him bless Israel instead (Numbers 23:11; 24:10). Verse 6 sums up the outcome.

decisions.choice: Pethor of Aram-naharaim: a town in upper Mesopotamia
decisions.reason: Aram-naharaim means "Aram of the two rivers", the land in the bend of the Euphrates in upper Mesopotamia (Genesis 24:10). Pethor lay near the Euphrates, "the River" (Numbers 22:5).

decisions.choice: Moab / the king of Moab
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only "he". Balanced names Moab and Readable names its king, to show who "he" is (m2).

decisions.choice: Mesopotamia
decisions.reason: Readable gives the familiar name of the region for Aram-naharaim. Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew name.

decisions.choice: les (os) ... salieron (salisteis) ... contra ti, te maldijera
decisions.reason: The Hebrew addresses the people as plural for the journey out of Egypt and as singular for Balaam's curse. Spanish follows both, so the plural_you span sits only on the first half; French (vous, toi) and Swahili (ninyi, -ku-) do the same.

decisions.choice: "các ngươi", then "ngươi" (L)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "you" is plural in the first half and singular in the second; Literal keeps the change.

decisions.choice: "Ba-la-am con trai Bê-ô", "Phê-thô-rơ", "A-ram Na-ha-ra-im" (L, B), "Mê-sô-pô-ta-mi" (R)
decisions.reason: The names as Numbers 22:5 and Joshua 13:22 write them; Readable names the region as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "너희가 ... 너를"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has plural "you" for the journey and singular "you" for the curse; the Literal keeps both. Aram-naharaim is "아람 나하라임" (Literal, Balanced) and "메소포타미아" (Readable), as the English does.

decisions.choice: vocês ... ti (L); two sentences, the first with vocês, the second with tu (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew moves from the plural "you" to the singular in mid-verse (m2). Literal follows it word by word; Balanced and Readable end the first sentence where the plural ends, so that no sentence mixes "vocês" and "tu", by the rule for the whole book (4:1; 6:1). The verse then goes on from verse 4, which Balanced ends with a comma as the English does.

records.literal_gloss: And not was willing Yahweh your God to listen to Balaam, and turned Yahweh your God for you the curse into blessing, for loved you Yahweh your God.

en.R: But {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God would not listen to Balaam. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} your God loved you, so {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} changed the curse into a blessing for you.

es.R: Pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios no quiso escuchar a Balaam. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios te amaba, y por eso cambió la maldición en una bendición para ti.

fr.R: Mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu n’a pas voulu écouter Balaam. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu t’aimait, alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a changé la malédiction en bénédiction pour toi.

vi.R: Nhưng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em không chịu nghe Ba-la-am. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em yêu thương anh em, nên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã biến lời nguyền rủa thành phước lành cho anh em.

decisions.choice: not willing to listen ... turned the curse into a blessing
decisions.reason: Each time Balaam set out to curse Israel, the LORD put a blessing in his mouth instead (Numbers 23:7-10, 18-24; 24:3-9). Nehemiah 13:2 repeats this verse. The LORD did not grant Balaam's wish to curse, so his attempt only produced blessing.

decisions.choice: because the LORD your God loved you: the reason is God's own love
alternatives: because the LORD your God loves you
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy grounds Israel's rescue and blessing in God's love, not in Israel's merit (4:37; 7:7-8; 10:15). The verb is in a form that can be read either as "loved" (when Balaam came) or as "loves".

decisions.choice: loved you, so he changed
decisions.reason: Readable puts the reason first and refers to the LORD the third time with a pronoun, to keep the sentence short. Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew order and the repeated name.

decisions.choice: refused to listen
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "was not willing to listen". Balanced says "refused", which carries the same sense of a firm choice; Literal keeps "was not willing".

records.literal_gloss: Not you shall seek their peace and their good all your days forever.

en.L: You shall not seek their peace or their good all your days, forever.
en.B: Never seek a peace treaty with them or work for their prosperity, as long as you live as a people.
en.R: As long as your nation lasts, never make a peace treaty with them or try to help them do well.

es.L: No buscarás su paz ni su bien en todos tus días, para siempre.
es.B: Nunca busques un tratado de paz con ellos ni procures su prosperidad, mientras existas como pueblo.
es.R: Mientras exista tu nación, nunca hagas un tratado de paz con ellos ni trates de ayudarles a prosperar.

fr.L: Tu ne rechercheras pas leur paix ni leur bien, tous tes jours, à jamais.
fr.B: Ne cherche jamais à conclure la paix avec eux ni à travailler à leur prospérité, aussi longtemps que tu existeras comme peuple.
fr.R: Aussi longtemps que ta nation existera, ne fais jamais de traité de paix avec eux, et n’essaie pas de les aider à prospérer.

sw.L: Usitafute amani yao wala mema yao siku zako zote, milele.
sw.B: Kamwe usitafute mkataba wa amani nao wala kujitahidi kwa ajili ya ustawi wao, maadamu unaishi kama taifa.
sw.R: Maadamu taifa lako lipo, usifanye kamwe mkataba wa amani nao wala kujaribu kuwasaidia wafanikiwe.

vi.L: Ngươi chớ tìm kiếm sự bình an hay sự thịnh vượng cho chúng mọi ngày của ngươi, đến đời đời.
vi.B: Đừng bao giờ tìm cách kết ước hòa bình với họ hay lo cho họ được thịnh vượng, bao lâu dân anh em còn tồn tại.
vi.R: Bao lâu dân anh em còn tồn tại, đừng bao giờ lập hiệp ước hòa bình với họ hay tìm cách giúp họ được thịnh vượng.

ko.L: 너는 평생토록 영원히 그들의 평안과 그들의 번영을 구하지 말라.
ko.B: 너희 민족이 있는 한, 그들과 평화 조약을 맺거나 그들이 잘되도록 힘쓰지 말라.
ko.R: 여러분의 나라가 있는 한, 그들과 결코 평화 조약을 맺거나 그들이 잘되도록 도와서는 안 됩니다.

pt.L: Não buscarás a paz deles nem o bem deles, todos os teus dias, para sempre.
pt.B: Nunca buscarás um tratado de paz com eles nem trabalharás pela prosperidade deles, enquanto existires como povo.
pt.R: Enquanto a tua nação existir, nunca faças um tratado de paz com eles nem procures ajudá-los a prosperar.

decisions.choice: seek their peace and their good: make treaties of friendship with them and promote their welfare
alternatives: never wish them well in any way
decisions.reason: "Peace" and "good" were used for friendly relations between nations, sealed by treaty (1 Kings 5:26; Jeremiah 29:7 uses "seek the peace" of a city). The command forbids Israel as a nation to seek alliance and friendship with Ammon and Moab. It does not order hatred of every person of those peoples, as Ruth shows. Ezra 9:12 quotes it of marriages with neighboring peoples.

decisions.choice: all your days forever: for as long as Israel exists
decisions.reason: The "you" is Israel as one people, so "all your days" is the life of the nation, and "forever" stresses it, as in verse 4.

decisions.choice: a peace treaty ... their prosperity
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "peace" and "good" mean between nations (m1). Literal keeps the bare words.

decisions.choice: as long as you live as a people / as long as your nation lasts
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make clear that "your days" is the life of the people, not of one person (m2).

source.text: לֹֽא־תְתַעֵ֣ב אֲדֹמִ֔י כִּ֥י אָחִ֖יךָ ה֑וּאסלֹא־תְתַעֵ֣ב מִצְרִ֔י כִּי־גֵ֖ר הָיִ֥יתָ בְאַרְצֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Not you shall abhor [an] Edomite, for your brother [is] he; not you shall abhor [an] Egyptian, for [a] sojourner you were in his land.

en.L: You shall not abhor an Edomite, for he [is] your brother; you shall not abhor an Egyptian, for you were a sojourner in his land.
en.B: Do not detest an Edomite, for he is your relative. Do not detest an Egyptian, because you lived as a outsider in his land.
en.R: Do not hate an Edomite, because the Edomites are your relatives. Do not hate an Egyptian, because you once lived as outsiders in their country.

es.L: No aborrecerás al edomita, porque él [es] tu hermano; no aborrecerás al egipcio, porque fuiste inmigrante en su tierra.
es.B: No detestes al edomita, porque es tu pariente. No detestes al egipcio, porque viviste como extranjero en su tierra.
es.R: No odies a un edomita, porque los edomitas son tus parientes. No odies a un egipcio, porque una vez viviste como extranjero en su país.

fr.L: Tu n’auras pas en abomination l’Édomite, car il [est] ton frère ; tu n’auras pas en abomination l’Égyptien, car tu as été un immigré dans son pays.
fr.B: Ne déteste pas l’Édomite, car il est ton parent. Ne déteste pas l’Égyptien, car tu as vécu en étranger dans son pays.
fr.R: Ne hais pas un Édomite, car les Édomites sont tes proches. Ne hais pas un Égyptien, car autrefois tu as vécu comme étranger dans leur pays.

sw.L: Usimwone Mwedomu kuwa chukizo, kwa maana yeye [ni] ndugu yako; usimwone Mmisri kuwa chukizo, kwa maana ulikuwa mgeni katika nchi yake.
sw.B: Usimchukie Mwedomu, kwa kuwa ni ndugu yako. Usimchukie Mmisri, kwa sababu uliishi kama mgeni katika nchi yake.
sw.R: Usimchukie Mwedomu, kwa sababu Waedomu ni ndugu zako. Usimchukie Mmisri, kwa sababu zamani uliishi kama mgeni katika nchi yao.

vi.L: Ngươi chớ ghê tởm người Ê-đôm, vì người ấy [là] anh em ngươi; ngươi chớ ghê tởm người Ai Cập, vì ngươi đã từng là ngoại kiều trong xứ người ấy.
vi.B: Đừng ghê tởm người Ê-đôm, vì họ là bà con của anh em. Đừng ghê tởm người Ai Cập, vì anh em đã từng sống như ngoại kiều trong xứ họ.
vi.R: Đừng ghét người Ê-đôm, vì họ là bà con của anh em. Đừng ghét người Ai Cập, vì có một thời anh em đã sống như người ngoại quốc trong xứ họ.

ko.L: 너는 에돔 사람을 혐오하지 말라. 그는 네 형제이기 때문이다. 너는 이집트 사람을 혐오하지 말라. 네가 그의 땅에서 나그네였기 때문이다.
ko.B: 에돔 사람을 싫어하여 멀리하지 말라. 그는 너희 친족이다. 이집트 사람도 싫어하여 멀리하지 말라. 너희가 그 땅에서 나그네로 살았기 때문이다.
ko.R: 에돔 사람을 미워하지 마십시오. 에돔 사람들은 여러분의 친족입니다. 이집트 사람도 미워하지 마십시오. 여러분이 전에 그 나라에서 나그네로 살았기 때문입니다.

pt.L: Não abominarás o edomita, porque ele [é] teu irmão; não abominarás o egípcio, porque foste imigrante na terra dele.
pt.B: Não terás aversão ao edomita, pois ele é teu parente. Não terás aversão ao egípcio, pois foste imigrante na terra dele.
pt.R: Não odeies o edomita, porque os edomitas são teus parentes. Não odeies o egípcio, porque tu já foste estrangeiro na terra deles.

decisions.choice: your brother: Edom descends from Esau, Jacob's brother
decisions.reason: Edom's people came from Esau, the twin brother of Jacob, who is Israel (Genesis 25:24-26; 36:1). Israel was told not to provoke them on the way (2:4-8). "Brother" here means a related people.

decisions.choice: you were a sojourner in his land: Israel lived in Egypt as foreigners
decisions.reason: Jacob's family went down to Egypt and was received there in a time of famine (Genesis 45-47). Though Egypt later made them slaves, Israel is to remember that it first found shelter there. The same reason is given for loving the sojourner (10:19).

decisions.choice: abhor: treat as detestable and shut out
decisions.reason: The verb comes from the word for "abomination" (17:1; 23:19). Israel is not to treat these two peoples as utterly unacceptable, as it must Ammon and Moab; verse 9 gives the result.

decisions.choice: relative / relatives
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "brother". Balanced and Readable say "relative", since a whole related people is meant (m1).

decisions.choice: you once lived as outsiders
decisions.reason: Readable makes the singular "you" plural, since the whole people lived in Egypt. Literal keeps "sojourner"; Balanced says "outsider", as for the sojourner elsewhere in Deuteronomy.

decisions.choice: abominar (L); ter aversão a (B); odiar (R)
decisions.reason: The verb comes from the word for "abomination" (m3), which this book renders "abominação" and "abominável"; Literal keeps the tie with "abominar". Balanced says "ter aversão" and Readable "odiar", as the English says "detest" and "hate"; "detestar" is kept for the different word Portuguese renders "detestável" (14:3).

decisions.choice: tu já foste estrangeiro (R)
decisions.reason: The English Readable makes the singular plural (r-en-2). Portuguese keeps the Hebrew singular, Israel spoken to as one people, by the rule for the whole book (4:9). The sojourner is "imigrante" at Literal and Balanced and "estrangeiro" at Readable, as 1:16 sets it.

source.text: בָּנִ֛ים אֲשֶׁר־יִוָּלְד֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם דּ֣וֹר שְׁלִישִׁ֑י יָבֹ֥א לָהֶ֖ם בִּקְהַ֥ל יְהוָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Children who will be born to them, [the] generation third, may enter of them into [the] assembly of Yahweh.

en.L: Children who are born to them, the third generation of them, may enter the assembly of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: The children born to them in the third generation may enter the assembly of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Their grandchildren, the third generation, may join the assembly of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Los hijos que les nazcan, la tercera generación de ellos, podrán entrar en la asamblea {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Los hijos que les nazcan en la tercera generación podrán entrar en la asamblea {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Sus nietos, la tercera generación, podrán formar parte de la asamblea {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Les enfants qui leur naîtront, la troisième génération d’entre eux, pourront entrer dans l’assemblée {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Les enfants qui leur naîtront à la troisième génération pourront entrer dans l’assemblée {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Leurs petits-enfants, la troisième génération, pourront faire partie de l’assemblée {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Watoto watakaozaliwa kwao, kizazi cha tatu chao, wanaweza kuingia katika kusanyiko la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Watoto watakaozaliwa kwao katika kizazi cha tatu wanaweza kuingia katika kusanyiko la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Wajukuu wao, yaani kizazi cha tatu, wanaweza kujiunga na kusanyiko la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Con cái sinh ra cho họ, thế hệ thứ ba của họ, được vào hội của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Con cháu của họ thuộc thế hệ thứ ba được vào hội của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Cháu của họ, tức là thế hệ thứ ba, được gia nhập hội của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그들에게서 태어나는 자녀들, 곧 그들의 삼 대째는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 총회에 들어올 수 있다.
ko.B: 그들에게서 태어난 삼 대째 자손은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 총회에 들어올 수 있다.
ko.R: 그들의 손자 손녀들, 곧 삼 대째 자손은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 총회에 들어올 수 있습니다.

pt.L: Os filhos que lhes nascerem, a terceira geração deles, poderão entrar na assembleia {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.B: Os filhos que lhes nascerem na terceira geração poderão entrar na assembleia {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.R: Os netos deles, a terceira geração, podem fazer parte da assembleia {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.

decisions.choice: the third generation: the grandchildren of those who first come to live in Israel
decisions.reason: "Them" are the Edomites and Egyptians of verse 8 who settle among Israel. Counting the settlers as the first generation, their grandchildren are the third. Some count the settlers' children as the first born "to them", which would make the third generation their great-grandchildren.

decisions.choice: may enter: the way into the assembly is open to them
decisions.reason: Unlike Ammon and Moab (verse 4), Edomites and Egyptians who live among Israel can in time be counted as full members of the LORD's assembly.

decisions.choice: grandchildren
decisions.reason: Readable says who the third generation are, following the counting in m1, and keeps "the third generation" beside it. If the other way of counting is right, the word would be "great-grandchildren". Literal and Balanced keep only "third generation".

source.text: כִּֽי־תֵצֵ֥א מַחֲנֶ֖ה עַל־אֹיְבֶ֑יךָ וְנִ֨שְׁמַרְתָּ֔ מִכֹּ֖ל דָּבָ֥ר רָֽע׃

records.literal_gloss: When you go out [as a] camp against your enemies, and you shall keep yourself from every thing evil.

en.L: When you go out [as] a camp against your enemies, then you shall keep yourself from every evil thing.
en.B: When you go out and camp against your enemies, guard yourself against anything that is wrong.
en.R: When your army goes out and sets up camp to fight your enemies, stay away from everything that is wrong.

es.L: Cuando salgas [en] campamento contra tus enemigos, te guardarás de toda cosa mala.
es.B: Cuando salgas a acampar contra tus enemigos, guárdate de todo lo que sea malo.
es.R: Cuando tu ejército salga y acampe para luchar contra tus enemigos, apártate de todo lo que esté mal.

fr.L: Quand tu sortiras [en] camp contre tes ennemis, tu te garderas de toute chose mauvaise.
fr.B: Quand tu partiras camper contre tes ennemis, garde-toi de tout ce qui est mal.
fr.R: Quand ton armée part en guerre et installe son camp pour combattre tes ennemis, tiens-toi loin de tout ce qui est mal.

sw.L: Utakapotoka [kama] kambi dhidi ya adui zako, ndipo utajilinda na kila jambo baya.
sw.B: Unapotoka kupiga kambi dhidi ya adui zako, jilinde na kila jambo lililo baya.
sw.R: Jeshi lako linapotoka na kupiga kambi ili kupigana na adui zako, kaa mbali na kila kitu kibaya.

vi.L: Khi ngươi kéo [quân] ra đóng trại đánh kẻ thù mình, thì ngươi phải giữ mình khỏi mọi điều xấu.
vi.B: Khi anh em ra đóng trại để đánh kẻ thù, hãy giữ mình khỏi mọi điều không đúng đắn.
vi.R: Khi quân đội anh em ra đóng trại để đánh kẻ thù, hãy tránh xa mọi điều sai trái.

ko.L: 네가 진을 쳐 네 원수들을 [치러] 나갈 때에는, 너는 모든 악한 것을 삼가라.
ko.B: 너희가 원수들을 치러 나가 진을 칠 때에는, 옳지 않은 일은 무엇이든 삼가라.
ko.R: 여러분의 군대가 원수들과 싸우러 나가 진을 칠 때에는, 옳지 않은 일은 무엇이든 멀리하십시오.

pt.L: Quando saíres [como] acampamento contra os teus inimigos, então te guardarás de toda coisa má.
pt.B: Quando saíres para acampar contra os teus inimigos, tu te guardarás de tudo o que é mau.
pt.R: Quando o teu exército sair e acampar para lutar contra os teus inimigos, deves te afastar de tudo o que é errado.

decisions.choice: go out as a camp: set out on campaign and camp as an army
decisions.reason: "Camp" stands without a preposition, describing how Israel goes out: as an army encamped. The rules that follow (verses 11-15) are for the war camp, where the LORD himself is present (verse 15).

decisions.choice: every evil thing: anything improper, including what makes a person or the camp unclean
decisions.reason: "Thing" can also mean "word" or "matter", and "evil" covers what is bad of any kind. The verses that follow show that it includes bodily uncleanness and filth, not only moral wrongs. The same "thing" returns in verse 15 ("anything indecent").

decisions.choice: your army goes out and sets up camp to fight
decisions.reason: Readable names the army and says what "go out as a camp against" means (m1). Literal and Balanced keep the shorter wording.

source.text: כִּֽי־יִהְיֶ֤ה בְךָ֙ אִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹא־יִהְיֶ֥ה טָה֖וֹר מִקְּרֵה־לָ֑יְלָה וְיָצָא֙ אֶל־מִח֣וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה לֹ֥א יָבֹ֖א אֶל־תּ֥וֹךְ הַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: If there is among you a man who not is clean from [a] happening of [the] night, and he shall go out to outside of the camp; not he shall come into [the] midst of the camp.

en.L: If there is among you a man who is not clean because of something that happened at night, then he shall go out outside the camp; he shall not come into the midst of the camp.
en.B: If any man among you is unclean because of an emission during the night, he must go outside the camp and not come inside it.
en.R: A man may become unclean because he had a discharge of semen in the night. If that happens, he must go outside the camp and stay out of it.

es.L: Si hay en medio de ti un hombre que no está puro por algo que le sucedió de noche, saldrá fuera del campamento; no entrará en medio del campamento.
es.B: Si alguno de tus hombres queda impuro por una emisión de semen durante la noche, debe salir del campamento y no entrar en él.
es.R: Puede que un hombre quede impuro porque tuvo una emisión de semen durante la noche. Si eso pasa, debe salir del campamento y quedarse fuera.

fr.L: S’il y a au milieu de toi un homme qui n’est pas pur à cause d’un accident de la nuit, il sortira hors du camp ; il n’entrera pas à l’intérieur du camp.
fr.B: Si l’un de tes hommes est impur à cause d’une émission de semence pendant la nuit, il doit sortir du camp et ne pas y rentrer.
fr.R: Il se peut qu’un homme devienne impur parce qu’il a eu un écoulement de semence pendant la nuit. Dans ce cas, il doit sortir du camp et rester dehors.

sw.L: Akiwa kati yako mtu ambaye si safi kwa sababu ya jambo lililompata usiku, atatoka nje ya kambi; hataingia katikati ya kambi.
sw.B: Mwanamume yeyote kati yako akiwa najisi kwa sababu ya kutokwa na shahawa usiku, lazima atoke nje ya kambi wala asiingie ndani yake.
sw.R: Huenda mwanamume akawa najisi kwa sababu alitokwa na shahawa usiku. Jambo hilo likitokea, lazima atoke nje ya kambi na abaki huko.

vi.L: Nếu ở giữa ngươi có một người không tinh sạch vì việc xảy ra ban đêm, thì người ấy phải ra ngoài trại quân; người ấy không được vào giữa trại quân.
vi.B: Nếu có người nào trong anh em bị ô uế vì xuất tinh ban đêm, người ấy phải ra ngoài trại quân và không được vào trong trại.
vi.R: Một người có thể bị ô uế vì xuất tinh lúc ban đêm. Nếu điều đó xảy ra, người ấy phải ra ngoài khu trại và ở bên ngoài.

ko.L: 네 가운데 밤에 일어난 일로 정결하지 않게 된 사람이 있으면, 그는 진 밖으로 나가야 하고, 진 안으로 들어오지 말 것이다.
ko.B: 너희 가운데 누가 밤에 몽정을 하여 부정하게 되었으면, 그는 진 밖으로 나가야 하고 진 안으로 들어오면 안 된다.
ko.R: 어떤 남자가 밤에 자다가 정액을 흘려 부정하게 될 수 있습니다. 그런 일이 있으면, 그는 진 밖으로 나가 머물러야 하고 진 안으로 들어오면 안 됩니다.

pt.L: Se houver no meio de ti um homem que não estiver puro por causa de um acontecimento da noite, ele sairá para fora do acampamento; não entrará no meio do acampamento.
pt.B: Se algum homem do teu meio ficar impuro por causa de uma emissão noturna, ele sairá do acampamento e não entrará nele.
pt.R: Um homem pode ficar impuro porque teve uma emissão de sêmen durante a noite. Se isso acontecer, ele deve sair do acampamento e ficar fora dele.

decisions.choice: not clean because of a happening of the night: unclean after a discharge of semen during sleep
decisions.reason: "A happening of the night" is a modest way of naming a seminal emission in sleep. Leviticus 15:16 makes a man unclean until evening after such an emission. In the holy war camp (verse 15) he must stay outside while he is unclean.

decisions.choice: an emission during the night / a discharge of semen in the night
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew's indirect phrase. Balanced and Readable say what it refers to (m1), Readable in plainer words.

decisions.choice: stay out of it
decisions.reason: Readable says "stay out" for "not come into the midst of the camp"; verse 12 says when he may return.

decisions.choice: "không tinh sạch" (L), "ô uế" (B, R); "trại quân" (L, B), "khu trại" (R)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's words for ritual uncleanness and for the camp, as in Leviticus and Numbers.

source.text: וְהָיָ֥ה לִפְנֽוֹת־עֶ֖רֶב יִרְחַ֣ץ בַּמָּ֑יִם וּכְבֹ֣א הַשֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ יָבֹ֖א אֶל־תּ֥וֹךְ הַֽמַּחֲנֶה׃

records.literal_gloss: And it shall be, at [the] turning of evening he shall wash with water, and at [the] going of the sun he may come into [the] midst of the camp.

en.L: And it shall be, at the turning of evening he shall wash with water, and when the sun goes down he may come into the midst of the camp.
en.B: Toward evening he is to bathe in water, and at sunset he may come back into the camp.
en.R: Late in the day he must wash himself with water. When the sun has gone down, he may come back into the camp.

es.L: Y sucederá que al caer la tarde se lavará con agua, y cuando se ponga el sol podrá entrar en medio del campamento.
es.B: Al atardecer se bañará en agua, y a la puesta del sol podrá volver al campamento.
es.R: Al final del día debe lavarse con agua. Cuando el sol se haya puesto, puede volver al campamento.

fr.L: Et il arrivera qu’au tournant du soir il se lavera dans l’eau, et au coucher du soleil il pourra entrer à l’intérieur du camp.
fr.B: Vers le soir, il se lavera dans l’eau, et au coucher du soleil il pourra revenir dans le camp.
fr.R: En fin de journée, il doit se laver avec de l’eau. Quand le soleil s’est couché, il peut revenir dans le camp.

sw.L: Na itakuwa, jioni ikikaribia ataoga kwa maji, na jua likishuka anaweza kuingia katikati ya kambi.
sw.B: Jioni inapokaribia aoge kwa maji, na jua linapotua anaweza kurudi kambini.
sw.R: Mchana ukiisha lazima aoge kwa maji. Jua likishatua, anaweza kurudi kambini.

vi.L: Và sẽ xảy ra, khi chiều xuống, người ấy phải tắm trong nước, và khi mặt trời lặn, người ấy được vào giữa trại quân.
vi.B: Khi chiều xuống, người ấy phải tắm rửa bằng nước, và lúc mặt trời lặn, người ấy được trở vào trại.
vi.R: Vào cuối ngày, người ấy phải tắm rửa bằng nước. Khi mặt trời đã lặn, người ấy được trở vào khu trại.

ko.L: 저녁이 될 무렵에 그는 물로 몸을 씻고, 해가 질 때에 진 안으로 들어올 수 있다.
ko.B: 저녁 무렵에 그는 물로 목욕하고, 해가 지면 진 안으로 돌아올 수 있다.
ko.R: 그는 저녁 무렵에 물로 몸을 씻어야 합니다. 해가 지고 나면 진 안으로 돌아와도 됩니다.

pt.L: E será que, ao cair da tarde, ele se lavará com água, e ao pôr do sol entrará no meio do acampamento.
pt.B: Ao entardecer, ele tomará banho, e ao pôr do sol poderá voltar ao acampamento.
pt.R: No fim da tarde, ele deve se lavar com água. Quando o sol se puser, ele pode voltar ao acampamento.

decisions.choice: toward evening ... when the sun goes down: the uncleanness lasts until evening
decisions.reason: Leviticus 15:16 says that a man after an emission must bathe in water and is unclean until evening. A new day began at sunset, so after washing he is clean again with the new day and may return.

decisions.choice: bathe in water
decisions.reason: The verb means to wash, often the whole body (Leviticus 15:16). Balanced says "bathe"; Literal and Readable say "wash".

source.text: וְיָד֙ תִּהְיֶ֣ה לְךָ֔ מִח֖וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה וְיָצָ֥אתָ שָׁ֖מָּה חֽוּץ׃

records.literal_gloss: And [a] hand shall be for you outside of the camp, and you shall go out there outside.

en.L: And you shall have a place outside the camp, and you shall go out there, outside.
en.B: Have a place set aside outside the camp, and go out there when you need to relieve yourself.
en.R: Choose a spot outside the camp where you can go to the toilet. Go out there to do it.

es.L: Y tendrás un lugar fuera del campamento, y saldrás allí, afuera.
es.B: Ten un lugar apartado fuera del campamento, y sal allí cuando necesites hacer tus necesidades.
es.R: Escoge un sitio fuera del campamento donde puedas ir al baño. Ve allí para hacerlo.

fr.L: Et tu auras un endroit hors du camp, et tu sortiras là, dehors.
fr.B: Aie un endroit réservé hors du camp, et sors-y quand tu as besoin de te soulager.
fr.R: Choisis un coin hors du camp où tu peux aller faire tes besoins. Va là-bas pour cela.

sw.L: Nawe utakuwa na mahali nje ya kambi, nawe utatoka kwenda huko, nje.
sw.B: Uwe na mahali palipotengwa nje ya kambi, nawe uende huko unapohitaji kujisaidia.
sw.R: Chagua mahali nje ya kambi unapoweza kwenda kujisaidia. Nenda huko kufanya hivyo.

vi.L: Và ngươi phải có một chỗ ở ngoài trại quân, và ngươi sẽ ra đó, ra bên ngoài.
vi.B: Hãy dành một chỗ ở ngoài trại quân, và khi cần đi đại tiện thì hãy ra đó.
vi.R: Hãy chọn một chỗ ngoài khu trại để đi vệ sinh. Hãy ra đó mà đi.

ko.L: 그리고 너는 진 밖에 한 곳을 두어, 그 바깥 그곳으로 나가야 한다.
ko.B: 진 밖에 한 곳을 정해 두고, 용변을 볼 때에는 그곳으로 나가라.
ko.R: 진 밖에 용변을 볼 곳을 정해 두십시오. 용변을 볼 때에는 그곳으로 나가야 합니다.

pt.L: E terás um lugar fora do acampamento, e sairás para lá, para fora.
pt.B: Terás um lugar reservado fora do acampamento, e sairás para lá quando precisares fazer as tuas necessidades.
pt.R: Escolhe um lugar fora do acampamento para fazeres as tuas necessidades. Vai até lá para isso.

decisions.choice: hand: a marked place, a set area
decisions.reason: The word means "hand", but it can mean a place or a marker that sets a place apart (Numbers 2:17, "each in his place"; 1 Samuel 15:12, a monument). Here it is a set area outside the camp, and verse 14 shows what it is for.

decisions.choice: go out there: to relieve oneself
decisions.reason: Verse 14 makes clear that the place is a latrine. Waste was to be kept outside the camp.

decisions.choice: place / spot
decisions.reason: Every level says what the word means here (m1), since "hand" would not be understood. Literal says "place".

decisions.choice: when you need to relieve yourself / to do it
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable state now the purpose that verse 14 shows (m2). Readable says "go to the toilet", the everyday phrase for it.

decisions.choice: fazer as tuas necessidades (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable state the purpose verse 14 shows (m2), as the English does. "Fazer as necessidades" is the ordinary, decent Portuguese phrase for it; "ir ao banheiro", the English Readable's "go to the toilet", speaks of a room a camp does not have.

source.text: וְיָתֵ֛ד תִּהְיֶ֥ה לְךָ֖ עַל־אֲזֵנֶ֑ךָ וְהָיָה֙ בְּשִׁבְתְּךָ֣ ח֔וּץ וְחָפַרְתָּ֣ה בָ֔הּ וְשַׁבְתָּ֖ וְכִסִּ֥יתָ אֶת־צֵאָתֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And [a] spade shall be for you with your equipment, and it shall be, when you sit outside, and you shall dig with it and turn and cover your excrement.

en.L: And you shall have a peg with your equipment, and it shall be, when you sit down outside, you shall dig with it, and turn and cover your excrement.
en.B: Carry a digging tool among your gear, and when you squat outside, dig a hole with it, and then cover up your excrement.
en.R: Keep a digging stick with your gear. When you go outside to relieve yourself, dig a hole with it. Then cover up your waste.

es.L: Y tendrás una estaca con tu equipo, y sucederá que cuando te sientes afuera, cavarás con ella, y volverás y cubrirás tu excremento.
es.B: Lleva una herramienta para cavar entre tu equipo, y cuando te agaches afuera, cava un hoyo con ella y luego cubre tu excremento.
es.R: Ten un palo para cavar junto con tus cosas. Cuando salgas a hacer tus necesidades, cava un hoyo con él. Luego cubre tus excrementos.

fr.L: Et tu auras un piquet avec ton équipement, et il arrivera, quand tu t’assiéras dehors, que tu creuseras avec lui, puis tu te retourneras et couvriras tes excréments.
fr.B: Porte un outil pour creuser parmi tes affaires, et quand tu t’accroupis dehors, creuse un trou avec, puis recouvre tes excréments.
fr.R: Garde un bâton pour creuser avec ton équipement. Quand tu sors pour faire tes besoins, creuse un trou avec. Ensuite, recouvre tes excréments.

sw.L: Nawe utakuwa na kigingi pamoja na vifaa vyako, na itakuwa, utakapoketi nje, utachimba kwacho, kisha utageuka na kufunika kinyesi chako.
sw.B: Beba kifaa cha kuchimbia pamoja na mizigo yako, na unapochuchumaa nje, chimba shimo kwacho, kisha ufunike kinyesi chako.
sw.R: Weka kijiti cha kuchimbia pamoja na vifaa vyako. Unapotoka kwenda kujisaidia, chimba shimo kwacho. Kisha funika uchafu wako.

vi.L: Và ngươi phải có một cái cọc trong đồ dùng của ngươi, và sẽ xảy ra, khi ngươi ngồi xuống bên ngoài, ngươi phải dùng nó đào [lỗ], rồi quay lại lấp phân của ngươi.
vi.B: Hãy mang theo một dụng cụ để đào trong hành trang của mình. Khi ngồi xuống bên ngoài, hãy dùng nó đào một cái lỗ, rồi lấp phân lại.
vi.R: Hãy giữ một cây que để đào trong đồ dùng của mình. Khi ra ngoài đi vệ sinh, hãy dùng nó đào một cái lỗ. Sau đó hãy lấp chất thải lại.

ko.L: 그리고 너는 네 장비에 말뚝을 두었다가, 네가 바깥에 앉을 때에 그것으로 땅을 파고, 돌아서서 네 배설물을 덮어라.
ko.B: 너희 장비 가운데 땅을 팔 도구를 가지고 다니다가, 밖에서 용변을 볼 때에는 그것으로 구덩이를 파고, 일을 본 뒤에 배설물을 덮어라.
ko.R: 장비 가운데 땅을 팔 막대기를 가지고 다니십시오. 밖에서 용변을 볼 때에는 그것으로 구덩이를 파고, 일을 본 뒤에 그 배설물을 흙으로 덮으십시오.

pt.L: E terás uma estaca entre o teu equipamento, e será que, quando te sentares lá fora, cavarás com ela, e voltarás e cobrirás o teu excremento.
pt.B: Terás entre o teu equipamento uma ferramenta de cavar. Quando te agachares lá fora, cavarás um buraco com ela e depois cobrirás os teus excrementos.
pt.R: Guarda um pau de cavar com o teu equipamento. Quando fores lá fora fazer as tuas necessidades, cava um buraco com ele. Depois cobre as fezes.

decisions.choice: peg: a pointed stake used as a digging tool
decisions.reason: The word is the name for a tent peg (Judges 4:21; Exodus 27:19). Here it is a pointed stick or small spade carried for digging.

decisions.choice: equipment: the soldier's gear, perhaps his weapons
decisions.reason: The word occurs only here, and its exact sense is not known. It is related to words for tools, and may mean weapons or kit. Either way the digging tool is part of what each man carries.

decisions.choice: when you sit outside: when you relieve yourself
decisions.reason: "Sit" here is a modest way of speaking of relieving oneself. "Turn" after "dig" means to go back and do the next thing: cover the waste.

decisions.choice: digging tool / digging stick
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "peg". Balanced and Readable name its use (m1).

decisions.choice: squat / go outside to relieve yourself; then
decisions.reason: Balanced says "squat" for "sit"; Readable says what is meant. Both render "turn" as "then", as m3 explains. Literal keeps "sit" and "turn".

source.text: כִּי֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ מִתְהַלֵּ֣ךְ׀בְּקֶ֣רֶב מַחֲנֶ֗ךָ לְהַצִּֽילְךָ֙ וְלָתֵ֤ת אֹיְבֶ֨יךָ֙ לְפָנֶ֔יךָ וְהָיָ֥ה מַחֲנֶ֖יךָ קָד֑וֹשׁ וְלֹֽא־יִרְאֶ֤ה בְךָ֙ עֶרְוַ֣ת דָּבָ֔ר וְשָׁ֖ב מֵאַחֲרֶֽיךָ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: For Yahweh your God [is] walking about in [the] midst of your camp to deliver you and to give your enemies before you, and shall be your camps holy, and not he shall see among you nakedness of a thing and turn back from after you.

en.L: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God walks about in the midst of your camp to deliver you and to give your enemies before you, and your camp shall be holy, so that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} does not see anything indecent among you and turn away from you.
en.B: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God moves about in your camp to rescue you and to hand your enemies over to you. So your camp must be holy, or {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} may see something indecent among you and turn away from you.
en.R: This is because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God walks around in your camp. He is there to keep you safe and to give you victory over your enemies. So your camp must be holy. Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will not see anything shameful among you and turn away from you.

es.L: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios anda en medio de tu campamento para librarte y para entregar a tus enemigos delante de ti; por tanto, tu campamento será santo, para que no vea en ti nada indecoroso y se aparte de ti.
es.B: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios se mueve por tu campamento para rescatarte y entregarte a tus enemigos. Así que tu campamento debe ser santo, o podría ver en ti algo indecente y apartarse de ti.
es.R: Esto es porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios anda por tu campamento. Él está allí para protegerte y darte la victoria sobre tus enemigos. Por eso tu campamento debe ser santo. Así no verá nada vergonzoso entre los tuyos ni se apartará de ti.

fr.L: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu se promène au milieu de ton camp pour te délivrer et pour livrer tes ennemis devant toi ; ton camp sera donc saint, afin qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne voie chez toi rien d’indécent et ne se détourne de toi.
fr.B: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu circule dans ton camp pour te sauver et pour te livrer tes ennemis. Ton camp doit donc être saint ; sinon {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} pourrait voir chez toi quelque chose d’indécent et se détourner de toi.
fr.R: C’est parce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu marche au milieu de ton camp. Il est là pour te protéger et te donner la victoire sur tes ennemis. Ton camp doit donc être saint. Alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne verra chez toi rien de honteux et ne se détournera pas de toi.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako anatembea katikati ya kambi yako ili kukuokoa na kuwatoa adui zako mbele yako; basi kambi zako zitakuwa takatifu, ili asione kwako kitu kisichofaa, akageuka akakuacha.
sw.B: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako hutembea kambini mwako ili kukuokoa na kuwatia adui zako mikononi mwako. Kwa hiyo kambi yako lazima iwe takatifu, la sivyo anaweza kuona kitu kisicho na adabu kati yako, akakuacha.
sw.R: Hii ni kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako hutembea katika kambi yako. Yuko hapo kukulinda na kukupa ushindi juu ya adui zako. Kwa hiyo kambi yako lazima iwe takatifu. Ndipo hataona kitu cha aibu kati yako na kukuacha.

vi.L: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi đi lại giữa trại quân ngươi để giải cứu ngươi và để phó kẻ thù ngươi trước mặt ngươi, nên trại quân ngươi phải thánh, để {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không thấy điều gì khiếm nhã ở giữa ngươi mà quay lưng khỏi ngươi.
vi.B: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em đi lại trong trại quân của anh em để giải cứu anh em và phó kẻ thù vào tay anh em. Vậy trại quân của anh em phải thánh, kẻo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thấy điều gì khiếm nhã ở giữa anh em mà quay lưng khỏi anh em.
vi.R: Đó là vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của anh em đi lại trong khu trại của anh em. Ngài ở đó để giữ anh em an toàn và cho anh em chiến thắng kẻ thù. Vậy khu trại của anh em phải thánh. Như vậy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ không thấy điều gì đáng xấu hổ ở giữa anh em mà quay lưng khỏi anh em.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 네 하나님께서 너를 구원하시고 네 원수들을 네 앞에 넘겨주시려고 네 진 가운데로 다니시기 때문이다. 그러므로 네 진은 거룩해야 한다. 그분이 네 가운데서 부끄러운 것을 보시고 너에게서 돌아서지 않으시게 하려는 것이다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 너희 하나님께서 너희를 구하시고 원수들을 너희 손에 넘겨주시려고 너희 진 가운데로 다니신다. 그러므로 너희 진은 거룩해야 한다. 그렇지 않으면 그분께서 너희 가운데서 부끄러운 것을 보시고 너희에게서 돌아서실 것이다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 여러분의 하나님께서 여러분의 진 가운데로 다니시기 때문입니다. 그분은 여러분을 지켜 주시고 원수들을 이기게 하시려고 그곳에 계십니다. 그러므로 여러분의 진은 거룩해야 합니다. 그래야 그분께서 여러분 가운데서 부끄러운 것을 보시고 여러분에게서 돌아서시는 일이 없을 것입니다.

pt.L: Porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o teu Deus, anda no meio do teu acampamento para te livrar e para entregar os teus inimigos diante de ti; e o teu acampamento será santo, para que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} não veja em ti coisa indecente e se afaste de ti.
pt.B: Pois {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o teu Deus, anda pelo teu acampamento para te salvar e para entregar a ti os teus inimigos. Por isso o teu acampamento será santo, para que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} não veja no meio de ti nada indecente e se afaste de ti.
pt.R: Isso porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o teu Deus, anda pelo teu acampamento. Ele está ali para te proteger e para te dar a vitória sobre os teus inimigos. Por isso o teu acampamento deve ser santo. Assim {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} não vai ver nada vergonhoso no meio de ti e não vai se afastar de ti.

decisions.choice: walks about in the midst of your camp: the LORD is present with Israel's army
decisions.reason: The same verb is used of God walking in the garden (Genesis 3:8) and of his promise to walk among his people (Leviticus 26:12). In war the LORD goes with Israel and fights for them (20:4). Because he is present, the camp must be fit for him.

decisions.choice: to give your enemies before you: to give you victory over them
decisions.reason: "Give ... before you" means to hand over to Israel in defeat (7:2, 23; 31:5).

decisions.choice: nakedness of a thing: something indecent or shameful
decisions.reason: The phrase joins "nakedness" with "thing" and names something exposed that ought to be covered, here filth left in the open. The same phrase in 24:1 is the ground for a divorce.

decisions.choice: your camps: the camp in each place it is set up
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has "camps" in the plural, either the camp each time the army sets up, or the several camps of one army. The verse began with "your camp" in the singular; the meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: hand your enemies over to you / give you victory over your enemies
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the idiom means (m2). Literal keeps "give your enemies before you".

decisions.choice: your camp
decisions.reason: Every level says "camp" in the singular for the plural "camps" (m4), since it is the same camp as at the start of the verse.

source.text: לֹא־תַסְגִּ֥יר עֶ֖בֶד אֶל־אֲדֹנָ֑יו אֲשֶׁר־יִנָּצֵ֥ל אֵלֶ֖יךָ מֵעִ֥ם אֲדֹנָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: Not you shall hand over [a] slave to his master who escapes to you from with his master.

en.L: You shall not hand over to his master a slave who escapes to you from his master.
en.B: If a slave has escaped from his master and taken refuge with you, do not hand him back to his master.
en.R: If a slave runs away from his master and comes to you for safety, do not send him back to his master.

es.L: No entregarás a su amo un esclavo que se escape a ti de su amo.
es.B: Si un esclavo ha huido de su amo y se ha refugiado contigo, no lo devuelvas a su amo.
es.R: Si un esclavo huye de su amo y viene a ti buscando protección, no lo mandes de vuelta a su amo.

fr.L: Tu ne livreras pas à son maître un esclave qui se sera réfugié chez toi loin de son maître.
fr.B: Si un esclave s’est échappé de chez son maître et s’est réfugié chez toi, ne le rends pas à son maître.
fr.R: Si un esclave s’enfuit de chez son maître et vient chercher refuge chez toi, ne le renvoie pas à son maître.

sw.L: Usimrudishe kwa bwana wake mtumwa aliyekukimbilia kutoka kwa bwana wake.
sw.B: Mtumwa akitoroka kwa bwana wake na kukimbilia kwako apate hifadhi, usimrudishe kwa bwana wake.
sw.R: Mtumwa akimtoroka bwana wake na kuja kwako ili apate usalama, usimrudishe kwa bwana wake.

vi.L: Ngươi chớ giao lại cho chủ nó một nô lệ đã trốn khỏi chủ mình mà đến với ngươi.
vi.B: Nếu một nô lệ trốn khỏi chủ mình mà đến nương náu nơi anh em, đừng giao người ấy lại cho chủ.
vi.R: Nếu một nô lệ trốn khỏi chủ mình và đến với anh em để được an toàn, đừng trả người ấy về cho chủ.

ko.L: 너는 자기 주인에게서 도망하여 너에게 피해 온 종을 그의 주인에게 넘겨주지 말라.
ko.B: 어떤 종이 자기 주인에게서 도망하여 너희에게 피해 왔으면, 그를 주인에게 넘겨주지 말라.
ko.R: 어떤 종이 주인에게서 도망하여 여러분에게 보호를 받으러 오면, 그를 주인에게 돌려보내지 마십시오.

pt.L: Não entregarás ao seu senhor o escravo que fugir do seu senhor para junto de ti.
pt.B: Se um escravo fugir do seu senhor e se refugiar contigo, não o entregarás de volta ao seu senhor.
pt.R: Se um escravo fugir do dono e vier a ti em busca de proteção, não o mandes de volta para o dono.

decisions.choice: a slave who escapes to you: most likely a slave fleeing from a foreign land
alternatives: a slave fleeing an Israelite master
decisions.reason: "To you" is Israel as a people, and verse 17 lets the slave settle in any of Israel's towns. So the case is most likely a slave who has fled from abroad into Israel. Treaties between kings in the ancient world often required runaway slaves to be sent back; this law forbids it. Whether it also covers a slave fleeing an Israelite master the text does not say.

decisions.choice: slave: a person owned by a master
decisions.reason: The word names someone in the service of a master and here owned by him, since he has a master to flee from.

decisions.choice: his master: a plural form used for one master
decisions.reason: The word for "master" is plural in form, as it often is when one owner is meant (Genesis 39:20; Exodus 21:4). It means one master.

decisions.choice: slave
decisions.reason: Every level keeps "slave": the law is about a person who is owned and has run away from his owner, so slavery itself is the point and "servant" would weaken it.

decisions.choice: If a slave has escaped ... do not hand him back
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable put the escape first and the command second, as English tells a case. Literal keeps the Hebrew order.

decisions.choice: "nô lệ" at every level
decisions.reason: A person owned by a master who has fled (meaning decisions); ownership is the point of the law, where the term sheet keeps "nô lệ".
As the term sheet: "종" for a servant or slave in Israel's law, "노예" for slavery in Egypt and slaves bought and sold.

source.text: עִמְּךָ֞ יֵשֵׁ֣ב בְּקִרְבְּךָ֗ בַּמָּק֧וֹם אֲשֶׁר־יִבְחַ֛ר בְּאַחַ֥ד שְׁעָרֶ֖יךָ בַּטּ֣וֹב ל֑וֹ לֹ֖א תּוֹנֶֽנּוּ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: With you he shall dwell, in your midst, in the place which he chooses in one of your gates, in the good to him; not you shall oppress him.

en.L: With you he shall dwell, in your midst, in the place that he chooses in one of your gates, where it is good to him; you shall not oppress him.
en.B: Let him live among you, in the place he chooses in any one of your towns, wherever suits him best. Do not mistreat him.
en.R: Let him live with you in whatever town he chooses, wherever he likes best. Do not treat him badly.

es.L: Contigo habitará, en medio de ti, en el lugar que él escoja en una de tus puertas, donde le [parezca] bien; no lo oprimirás.
es.B: Déjalo vivir entre los tuyos, en el lugar que él elija en cualquiera de tus ciudades, donde mejor le parezca. No lo maltrates.
es.R: Déjalo vivir contigo en la ciudad que él quiera, donde más le guste. No lo trates mal.

fr.L: Il habitera avec toi, au milieu de toi, dans le lieu qu’il choisira dans l’une de tes portes, là où [il est] bon pour lui ; tu ne l’opprimeras pas.
fr.B: Laisse-le habiter chez toi, à l’endroit qu’il choisira dans l’une de tes villes, là où cela lui convient le mieux. Ne le maltraite pas.
fr.R: Laisse-le vivre chez toi, dans la ville qu’il veut, là où il se plaît le plus. Ne le traite pas mal.

sw.L: Atakaa pamoja nawe, katikati yako, mahali atakapopachagua katika mojawapo ya malango yako, pale palipo pema kwake; usimdhulumu.
sw.B: Mwache aishi kati yako, mahali atakapopachagua katika mji wako wowote, popote panapomfaa zaidi. Usimtendee vibaya.
sw.R: Mwache aishi pamoja nawe katika mji wowote atakaouchagua, popote anapopenda zaidi. Usimtendee vibaya.

vi.L: Người ấy sẽ ở với ngươi, ở giữa ngươi, tại nơi người ấy chọn trong một cổng [thành] nào của ngươi, nơi người ấy thấy tốt; ngươi chớ áp bức người ấy.
vi.B: Hãy để người ấy sống giữa anh em, tại nơi người ấy chọn trong bất cứ thành nào của anh em, ở đâu người ấy thấy thích hợp nhất. Đừng ngược đãi người ấy.
vi.R: Hãy để người ấy sống với anh em trong bất cứ thành nào người ấy chọn, ở nơi nào người ấy thích nhất. Đừng đối xử tệ với người ấy.

ko.L: 그는 너와 함께, 네 가운데서, 네 성문들 가운데 그가 택하는 곳, 그에게 좋은 곳에서 살게 하여라. 너는 그를 학대하지 말라.
ko.B: 그가 너희 가운데서 너희 성읍 가운데 어디든 마음에 드는 곳을 골라 함께 살게 하여라. 그를 괴롭히지 말라.
ko.R: 그 사람이 여러분과 함께, 어느 성읍이든 자기가 고른 곳, 가장 마음에 드는 곳에서 살게 하십시오. 그를 함부로 대하면 안 됩니다.

pt.L: Contigo habitará, no meio de ti, no lugar que ele escolher, numa das tuas portas, onde lhe for bom; não o oprimirás.
pt.B: Ele morará contigo, no meio de ti, no lugar que escolher, em qualquer uma das tuas cidades, onde lhe parecer melhor. Não o maltratarás.
pt.R: Deixa que ele more contigo na cidade que ele escolher, onde ele gostar mais. Não o trates mal.

decisions.choice: the place which he chooses: the slave's free choice, in the words used for the LORD's chosen place
decisions.reason: "The place which he chooses" is the phrase Deuteronomy uses over and over for the place the LORD will choose for his name (12:5, 11, 14). Here the one who chooses is the runaway slave. The freedom to choose where to live is his own.

decisions.choice: oppress: mistreat or take advantage of
decisions.reason: The verb is used for wronging the weak, above all the sojourner (Exodus 22:20; Leviticus 19:33). The slave who has fled may not be exploited by those who take him in.

decisions.choice: your gates: your towns
decisions.reason: As elsewhere in Deuteronomy, "your gates" stands for the towns of Israel (17:2).

decisions.choice: towns
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "gates". Balanced and Readable say "towns", the thing the word stands for here (m3).

decisions.choice: "그가 택하는 곳"
decisions.reason: The Literal uses the same verb "택하다" as for the place the LORD will choose (16:2, 6), so the echo the meaning decision notes is kept.

decisions.choice: no lugar que ele escolher (L); no lugar que escolher (B); na cidade que ele escolher (R)
decisions.reason: The words echo the formula of the place the LORD will choose (m1). Every level keeps the verb "escolher" in the future subjunctive, as the formula has it in this book (12:5), so the echo is heard; here the one who chooses is the slave.

source.text: לֹא־תִהְיֶ֥ה קְדֵשָׁ֖ה מִבְּנ֣וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְלֹֽא־יִהְיֶ֥ה קָדֵ֖שׁ מִבְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

records.literal_gloss: Not shall be [a] female cult prostitute from [the] daughters of Israel, and not shall be [a] male cult prostitute from [the] sons of Israel.

en.L: There shall be no female cult prostitute among the daughters of Israel, and there shall be no male cult prostitute among the sons of Israel.
en.B: No Israelite woman is to become a shrine prostitute, and no Israelite man is to become a shrine prostitute.
en.R: No Israelite woman or man may work as a prostitute at a shrine.

es.L: No habrá prostituta sagrada entre las hijas de Israel, ni habrá prostituto sagrado entre los hijos de Israel.
es.B: Ninguna israelita debe hacerse prostituta del santuario, y ningún israelita debe hacerse prostituto del santuario.
es.R: Ninguna mujer ni ningún hombre de Israel debe trabajar como prostituta o prostituto en un santuario.

fr.L: Il n’y aura pas de prostituée sacrée parmi les filles d’Israël, et il n’y aura pas de prostitué sacré parmi les fils d’Israël.
fr.B: Aucune Israélite ne doit devenir prostituée de sanctuaire, et aucun Israélite ne doit devenir prostitué de sanctuaire.
fr.R: Aucune femme ni aucun homme d’Israël ne doit se prostituer dans un sanctuaire.

sw.L: Pasiwe na kahaba wa mahali pa ibada miongoni mwa binti za Israeli, wala pasiwe na mwanamume kahaba wa mahali pa ibada miongoni mwa wana wa Israeli.
sw.B: Mwanamke yeyote Mwisraeli asiwe kahaba wa mahali pa ibada, wala mwanamume yeyote Mwisraeli asiwe kahaba wa mahali pa ibada.
sw.R: Mwanamke au mwanamume yeyote wa Israeli asifanye ukahaba mahali pa ibada.

vi.L: Không được có gái mại dâm ở đền miếu trong các con gái Y-sơ-ra-ên, và không được có đàn ông mại dâm ở đền miếu trong các con trai Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Không một người nữ Y-sơ-ra-ên nào được làm gái mại dâm ở đền miếu, và không một người nam Y-sơ-ra-ên nào được làm đàn ông mại dâm ở đền miếu.
vi.R: Không người đàn bà hay đàn ông Y-sơ-ra-ên nào được làm nghề mại dâm tại các đền miếu.

ko.L: 이스라엘의 딸들 가운데 신전 창녀가 있어서는 안 되고, 이스라엘의 아들들 가운데 신전 남창이 있어서는 안 된다.
ko.B: 이스라엘 여자는 아무도 신전에서 몸을 파는 사람이 되어서는 안 되고, 이스라엘 남자도 아무도 신전에서 몸을 파는 사람이 되어서는 안 된다.
ko.R: 이스라엘 사람은 여자든 남자든 아무도 신전에서 몸을 파는 일을 하면 안 됩니다.

pt.L: Não haverá prostituta cultual entre as filhas de Israel, e não haverá prostituto cultual entre os filhos de Israel.
pt.B: Nenhuma mulher israelita será prostituta de santuário, e nenhum homem israelita será prostituto de santuário.
pt.R: Nenhuma mulher e nenhum homem de Israel pode se prostituir num santuário.

decisions.choice: a woman or man given over to sexual service connected with a shrine
alternatives: a consecrated woman or man serving at a shrine, without sexual service
decisions.reason: The two words come from the root meaning "holy" or "set apart", and name a woman and a man set apart for a god or a shrine. In Genesis 38:15, 21-22 the same woman is called a "prostitute" and a "cult prostitute", and Hosea 4:14 sets the word beside prostitutes at sacrifices, so sexual service is in view. How such service worked, and whether it was a rite of worship or prostitution practiced at shrines, is not certain. Kings of Judah later removed such men from the land (1 Kings 15:12; 2 Kings 23:7).

decisions.choice: of the daughters ... of the sons of Israel: no Israelite woman or man
decisions.reason: "Daughters of Israel" and "sons of Israel" mean Israelite women and Israelite men. The law forbids any of the people to take this role.

decisions.choice: shrine prostitute / prostitute at a shrine
decisions.reason: Literal says "cult prostitute". Balanced and Readable say "shrine", a plainer word for the place of worship the term points to (m1).

decisions.choice: "gái mại dâm ở đền miếu", "đàn ông mại dâm ở đền miếu"
decisions.reason: A woman or man given over to sexual service at a shrine (meaning decision, footnoted); "đền miếu" marks a shrine of other gods, not the LORD's house.

decisions.choice: "신전 창녀", "신전 남창" (Literal), "신전에서 몸을 파는 사람" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The words describe sexual service tied to a shrine, as the meaning decision says; plain modern words are used rather than the older Bible terms.

decisions.choice: prostituta cultual, prostituto cultual (L); prostituta de santuário, prostituto de santuário (B)
decisions.reason: Literal says "cultual" for the English "cult", Balanced "de santuário" for "shrine", naming the place of worship the words point to (m1). Portuguese has the masculine "prostituto", so the two nouns stand side by side as in the Hebrew.

source.text: לֹא־תָבִיא֩ אֶתְנַ֨ן זוֹנָ֜ה וּמְחִ֣יר כֶּ֗לֶב בֵּ֛ית יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ לְכָל־נֶ֑דֶר כִּ֧י תוֹעֲבַ֛ת יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ גַּם־שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Not you shall bring [the] hire of [a] prostitute and [the] price of [a] dog [into the] house of Yahweh your God for any vow, for [an] abomination of Yahweh your God [are] also both of them.

en.L: You shall not bring the hire of a prostitute or the price of a dog into the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God for any vow, for both of them also [are] an abomination to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God.
en.B: Do not bring a prostitute's earnings or the wages of a male prostitute into the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God to pay any vow, because both are detestable to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God.
en.R: Do not bring money earned by a prostitute, woman or man, into the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God to pay for something you promised {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} your God hates both kinds of payment.

es.L: No traerás la paga de una prostituta ni el precio de un perro a la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios por ningún voto, porque abominación [son] para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios también ambas cosas.
es.B: No lleves las ganancias de una prostituta ni la paga de un prostituto a la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios para cumplir ningún voto, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios detesta las dos cosas.
es.R: No lleves a la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tu Dios dinero ganado con la prostitución, sea de mujer o de hombre, para pagar algo que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} prometiste. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios odia esas dos clases de pago.

fr.L: Tu n’apporteras pas le salaire d’une prostituée ni le prix d’un chien dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu pour aucun vœu, car tous les deux aussi [sont] une abomination pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu.
fr.B: N’apporte pas le gain d’une prostituée ni le salaire d’un prostitué dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu pour t’acquitter d’un vœu, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu a en horreur l’un comme l’autre.
fr.R: N’apporte pas dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ton Dieu de l’argent gagné par la prostitution, que ce soit par une femme ou par un homme, pour payer ce que tu {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} as promis. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu déteste ces deux sortes de paiement.

sw.L: Usilete ujira wa kahaba wala bei ya mbwa katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako kwa nadhiri yoyote, kwa maana vyote viwili pia [ni] chukizo kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako.
sw.B: Usilete mapato ya kahaba wala ujira wa mwanamume kahaba katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako ili kutimiza nadhiri yoyote, kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako anavichukia kabisa vyote viwili.
sw.R: Usilete katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako fedha zilizopatikana kwa ukahaba, uwe wa mwanamke au wa mwanamume, ili kulipa kitu ulichomwahidi. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako anachukia malipo ya aina zote mbili.

vi.L: Ngươi chớ đem tiền công của gái điếm hay giá của con chó vào nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi để trả bất cứ lời khấn nguyện nào, vì cả hai thứ ấy cũng [là] điều ghê tởm đối với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi.
